theorems.name: Submission.ind_top_dim_integer_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ u : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))), ∃ k : ℤ, u x = k) ∧ (∀ K : Set (Eucl (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn u K volume) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), X ω = ∫ x in U, u x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume
